title: KAOS dataset layout (layout.yaml), spec version 1
description: Shared byte for byte by kaos-lib (src/kaos_lib/layouts/shared) and kaos-lake (pkg/kaos/templates/shared). It uses only the keywords both implementations evaluate: type, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, maxItems, minProperties, maxProperties, minimum, maximum, minLength, maxLength, pattern. Rules no schema can say (unique keys, paths inside the dataset, patterns that compile) are checked in code, the same way in both.

name.description: The layout's id: the kaos.template label of datasets made with it.

version.description: The layout's own version, free form.

parameters.description: Values asked when a dataset is created; skeleton files use them.

type.description: text: one line; list: one item per line.

form_key.description: Top-level key of form_file that holds this value, for editing.

form_file.description: File read back into the parameters when a dataset is edited.

skeleton.description: What create writes: empty folders and files whose text may use {{placeholders}}.

rules.description: Declarative validation. kaos-lib and kaos-lake both evaluate these.

required.description: Each pattern must match at least one file.

allowed.description: When set, every file must match one of these patterns.

needs.description: The partner file; {stem} is the matched path below the pattern's fixed folders, without its extension.

pattern.description: Every non-blank line, trimmed, must match all of it (RE2 syntax shared by Go and Python: no lookaround, no backreferences).

schema.description: A schema for the file's YAML, in the keywords this file uses.

include.description: Download only the files these patterns match (default: everything).

hook.description: Python module (module or module:object) with validate() and/or materialize(). Only kaos-lib runs it; kaos-lake never runs code from a layout.
